name: Eager for the Fight
summary: After disembarking from a Transport, an Orks unit can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls for the rest of the turn.

name: Da Boss Is Watchin’
summary: If you have a Warboss on or transported within the battlefield and have not called a Waaagh! this turn, you may call a second Waaagh! this battle, affecting only Warboss, Nobz and Meganobz units.

name: Da Hunt Is On
summary: Each Command phase, mark one enemy Monster, Vehicle, or Character as Prey. A charging Beast Snagga unit within 12" of it can re-roll the charge and must end engaged with it; attacks against Prey get +1 Armour Penetration.

name: Try Dat Button!
summary: When a Mek, Orks Walker, or Grots Vehicle unit shoots or fights, roll (or pick) a D6 result granting its weapons Sustained Hits 1, Lethal Hits, or +2 Armour Penetration on a Critical Wound; picking instead of rolling also adds Hazardous.

name: Here Be Loot
summary: Each Command phase, mark one objective as your loot objective. Orks Infantry, Mounted, or Walker attacks gain Sustained Hits 1 when their unit or the target is within range of it.

name: Adrenaline Junkies
summary: Speed Freeks units can shoot and declare a charge in a turn they Advanced or Fell Back.

name: Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!
summary: Orks Infantry ranged attacks gain Assault; while your Waaagh! is active, they also gain Sustained Hits 1 in the Shooting phase.

name: Thundering Wagons
summary: Friendly Battlewagon, Hunta Rig, and Kill Rig units gain the Wagon keyword; Wagon units re-roll charge rolls and can treat Advance rolls as a 6. Exclusive Wagons-tagged detachment.

name: Turbo Boostas
summary: A Speed Freeks or Trukk unit (non-Aircraft) can turbo-boost on an Advance instead of rolling: it moves a straight 24" and its ranged weapons gain Assault for the turn, but it cannot charge that turn.

name: Get Stuck In
summary: Orks melee weapons gain Sustained Hits 1.
